name: @local/dsh-boot-spectacle
description: A monochrome Harness OS startup sequence for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: access gate with a female voice prompt, typewriter headlines, a live session profile, a zero-to-full circular radar with a single needle synced to the radar progress, Chinese-then-English welcome voice, glitch transitions, synthesized loading audio, and replay when restored from the system tray.
